storyCards.headline: Shakin': A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Eddie Money's "Shakin'" reached #63 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #63 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Shakin' was released in 1982.
